rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a large, often luxurious house used as a countryside or seaside retreat.

example.english: Our villa is in Sai Kung, and we only go there to stay on weekends.
example.traditional: 我哋間別墅喺西貢，周末先至過去住。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 bit6 seoi5 hai2 sai1 gung3 zau1 mut6 sin1 zi3 gwo3 heoi3 zyu6
